newsitem.title: DUBAI: August Dubai air cargo volumes up yr/yr five pct.
newsitem.headline: August Dubai air cargo volumes up yr/yr five pct.

text.p: Dubai airport cargo volumes rose five percent in August to 27,843 tonnes from 26,482 tonnes in the same month last year, Dubai Cargo Village figures show.
August's tonnages were below the 29,739 handled in July.

Uplifted cargo -- or exports -- fell a year-on-year 2.7 percent in August to 13,513 tonnes, while discharged cargo -- or imports -- moved up 13.8 percent to 14,330 tonnes. These figures include transit goods but do not include courier and mail items.
Trans-shipments in the month totalled 4,466 tonnes, a 10 percent increase on August 1995's figure.
Sea-air freight volumes fell a year-on-year 16.4 percent in August to nearly 5,121 tonnes.
This is the fifth consecutive fall so far in 1996. It follows year-on-year drops of 34.7 percent in April, 17.7 percent in May, 3.3 percent in June and 8.6 percent in July.
Dubai is the second largest emirate and commercial centre of the seven members of the United Arab Emirates. Its airport is the busiest in the Gulf.
